${modID}:GravitySwitchEvent.NAME: Gravity Switch
DESCRIPTIONS: You come across a very large switch attached to an animated monitor. The monitor is scrolling through up arrows. Behind the switch is a deep fall where you cannot see the end.

You pull the switch. Your body lifts into the air. As you ascend by some gravitational force, you whip your torso to land feet first on the ceiling. NL NL You find yourself feeling very weightless and flexible.
#rMadness. You laugh to yourself. NL NL #r@HAHAHA!@ The Spire consumes all...

You drop into the depths below and find an item capsule full of rings tucked away in a corner. NL NL You grab the rings. However, when you press forward, you find yourself at a dead end to see a small crevice in the ceiling, just big enough to squeeze through. You find yourself backtracking and a little bit frustrated at the whole experience.

You walk between a random prop and the wall. Through some unholy, black magic witchcraft, you disappear into the wall and start flying inexplicably fast. You can see the inside and outside of objects and they're hollow. NL NL You reach your destination. That little trip through time and space probably took some years out of your life, but look at the time you saved!
